prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A cinematic, shallow depth-of-field photograph set in a classroom, focusing on two teenage boys seated at wooden desks. Both boys wear crisp white dress shirts and dark ties, their attire formal and slightly rumpled, suggesting a school uniform. The boy on the left leans forward, his elbow on the desk and his hand supporting his head, gazing intently at his paper with a look of concentration and mild fatigue. The boy on the right, partially out of frame, is also writing, his posture upright and focused. The foreground is dominated by the back of an empty wooden chair, its surface worn and etched with faint graffiti, adding a sense of realism and history to the setting. The background is softly blurred, with hints of a window and classroom walls, bathing the scene in cool, natural light that creates gentle shadows and a contemplative mood. The color palette is muted, with earthy browns of the desks and chairs contrasting against the stark whites and deep blues of the students’ uniforms. The overall style is reminiscent of an art-house film, with a careful composition that emphasizes the quiet tension and introspective atmosphere of an exam or study session. The camera angle is low and intimate, drawing the viewer into the students’ world and highlighting the emotional weight of the moment.
